items: RoughModifier: Geometric path modifier that converts sharp, rigid vector contours into authentic rough.js hand-drawn sketches (identical seed -> identical look to Excalidraw).

cells: RoughModifier._approximateCubic: private _approximateCubic( p0x: number, p0y: number, c1x: number, c1y: number, c2x: number, c2y: number, p3x: number, p3y: number, depth: number, scale: number, out: number[] ): void

Recursively approximates a cubic Bézier curve with quadratic Bézier segments. Single quad control point: C = (3(c1 + c2) - p0 - p3) / 4. Splits at t = 0.5 (de Casteljau) when approximation error exceeds ~0.05 px (depth <= 4). Body operations (including nested callbacks): calls to `this._approximateCubic`, `out.push`.

items: RoughShape: Retiam VGroup representing an authentic rough.js hand-drawn illustration. Renders solid background fills, sketchy hachure fills, and multi-pass sketchy outlines.
roughify: Functional convenience helper to turn any Retiam VectorEntity or SVG path string into an authentic rough.js hand-drawn illustration.
roughBoilAnim: Creates an Animation that continuously boils (jitters) the rough.js illustration over time. Can be played standalone or concurrently with other animations:
roughCreateAnim: Creates an entrance animation drawing the outline and fill while simultaneously boiling rough sketch lines at 12 FPS.
